title: Redis piyush garg
content:
Redis Crash Course: Detailed Notes

Transcript ke saare points yahan hain. Jahan instructor ne galti ki ya kuch purana bola, wahan Correction/Note se mark kiya hai.

0. Video ka Roadmap

  1. Redis kya hai aur kaunsi problem solve karta hai (whiteboard pe)
  2. Architecture samajhna: Redis ko app me kaise fit karte hain
  3. Installation (Docker se)
  4. Redis CLI aur GUI
  5. Data types: Strings, Lists, Sets, Hashes, Sorted Sets, Streams, Geo, Bitmaps, Bitfields, Time Series
  6. Pub/Sub
  7. Node.js me implementation (ioredis)
  8. Practical project: Express API ko cache karke fast banana
  9. Instructor ka real production use case

1. Redis kya hai?


Redis = REmote DIctionary Server
  • Official definition (redis.io): open-source, in-memory data store, jo millions of developers use karte hain.
  • Do keywords: open source aur in-memory.
  • In-memory = RAM / primary memory me data store hota hai.
  • RAM ki properties:
    • Bahut fast
    • Par temporary / volatile (restart pe data ja sakta hai, jab tak persistence on na ho)
  • Redis ek server hai, aur ek in-memory database bhi.
  • Default port: 6379.
  • Redis akela aisa tool nahi hai, aur bhi services hain jo yeh kaam karti hain, par Redis sabse zyada use hota hai.

2. Redis kaunsi Problem solve karta hai?

2.1 Normal architecture (bina Redis)

User  →  Server  →  Database
         (Node.js / Lambda /      (Postgres / MongoDB)
          koi bhi server)
  • User app ka page visit karta hai, server DB se data query karta hai.
  • Query simple nahi hoti: multiple tables, joins, foreign key lookups.
  • Server data compute karke user ko deta hai.

Example: Facebook / LinkedIn / Instagram khologe to ek saath dikhta hai:

  • Kitne friend requests pending hain
  • Kitne friends hain
  • Recent chats
  • Tumhara feed
  • Profile photo

Yeh sab alag-alag tables se aata hai.

2.2 Problem kahan hai?

Architecture kaam karta hai, par agar user page refresh kare to?

# Problem Impact
1 Same data dobara query/recompute hota hai Unnecessary DB reads, bill badhta hai
2 Data multiple tables se aata hai Response time bahut badh jata hai
3 User ko wahi wait phir se karna padta hai User bolega "app slow hai, maine bas refresh kiya aur phir utna hi wait karna pada"

Seedha statement: Hum data ko re-query nahi karna chahte, hum recompute kar rahe hain, aur response time bhi zyada hai.

3. Solution: Redis ko beech me lagao (Caching)

Ek alag Redis server banao (whiteboard pe blue box, kyunki Redis ka logo red hota hai).

3.1 Flow (Cache-Aside)

First request (Cache Miss)

  1. User server pe hit karta hai
  2. Server Redis se poochta hai: "Is user ka data hai?"
  3. Redis (abhi naya hai, empty): "Nahi hai"
  4. Server DB pe jaake saari expensive queries chalata hai (slow)
  5. Data aane ke baad server Redis ko bolta hai: "Isko future ke liye yaad rakho" → cache ho gaya
  6. User ko data return hota hai
    (User ko pehli baar slow laga)

Second request / refresh (Cache Hit)

  1. Server Redis se poochta hai
  2. Redis: "Haan, data hai"
  3. Server cache se data nikaal ke user ko de deta hai

3.2 Fayde

  1. Bahut fast response, kyunki Redis in-memory hai
  2. DB queries/reads bache, to cost bhi kam
  3. User khush

Terms: Data mila = Cache Hit. Data nahi mila, DB jaana pada = Cache Miss.

4. Computed Data

Computed data = wo data jo DB me directly stored nahi hai, calculate karna padta hai.

Example: Unread message count

  • DB me messages table hai, usme sirf messages hain.
  • DB ko pata nahi ki "10" koi value hai, use sirf messages dikhte hain.
  • Count nikalne ke liye query chalani padti hai: "is user ke kitne messages unread hain" → result 10.

Redis ke saath:

  • Pehli baar DB se count nikaalo (10)
  • Redis me sirf number 10 store karo (poora data nahi, sirf computed value)
  • Agli baar end user ko seedha Redis se dikhao
  • Naya message aaye to: DB me message save karo aur Redis me value increment kar do
  • Isse DB se baar-baar count compute nahi karna padta

Takeaway: Computed values ke case me Redis bahut bada optimization deta hai.

5. Installation aur Setup

5.1 Official docs

  • Site: redis.io → Get Started
  • Docs bahut easy, well-written aur samajhne me simple hain.
  • Install options: Linux, macOS, Windows, Redis Stack.
  • Do tareeke: Standalone install ya Docker.

5.2 Docker kyun recommend kiya?

  1. Production me Redis Docker ke andar hi chalta hai
  2. Docker aana chahiye, ye ek important skill hai
  3. Sab same page pe rahenge, OS (Windows/Mac/Linux) ka difference problem nahi banega

5.3 Redis vs Redis Stack

Redis Redis Stack
Contents Sirf Redis server Redis server + GUI tool (RedisInsight) + extra modules
Kab use karein Production Learning / development
  • Instructor ne Redis Stack use kiya, kyunki GUI se visualize kar sakte hain ki Redis ke andar kya ho raha hai.
  • Production me GUI ki zarurat nahi hoti.

5.4 Docker command

bash
docker run -d --name redis-stack -p 6379:6379 -p 8001:8001 redis/redis-stack:latest
Part Matlab
-d Detached mode, background me chalega
--name redis-stack Container ka naam
-p 6379:6379 Actual Redis server ka port expose
-p 8001:8001 GUI (RedisInsight) ka port expose
redis/redis-stack:latest Image

Steps:

  1. Pehle Docker daemon (Docker Desktop) on karo
  2. Terminal me command paste karo
  3. Pehli baar image pull hoti hai, to time lagega
  4. Command chalne ke baad container ID print hoga

5.5 Verify karna

  • Docker Desktop me container running dikhega, aur dono ports (6379, 8001) exposed dikhenge.
  • Browser me http://localhost:8001:
    • Terms accept karo → GUI Redis client khulega
    • Isme saari keys, values dikhengi
    • Neeche CLI option bhi hai, jisme PING → PONG aata hai
    • Instructor actual terminal use karte hain, GUI ka CLI nahi
  • docker ps se bhi dekh sakte ho container up hai.

5.6 Container ke andar jaake Redis CLI

bash
docker exec -it <container_id> bash
redis-cli
PING        # → PONG
  • -it = interactive
  • Pehle bash me gaye, phir redis-cli chalaya (seedha docker exec -it <id> redis-cli bhi chalta hai)
  • PONG aaya = Redis server up and running

5.7 Instructor ki GUI ke baare me advice

  • GUI se values edit bhi kar sakte ho (jaise grk → update ho gaya).
  • Par zyada use mat karo, kyunki production me ye nahi hota.
  • Production me sirf terminal / code se kaam hota hai. Yeh yaad rakho.

6. Redis Data Types: Overview

  • Data types = data structures (DSA wale).
  • Redis cache hai, aur cache ke liye alag-alag data structures chahiye ho sakte hain: strings, arrays, hash maps...
  • Redis ye sab out of the box deta hai.
  • Types: Strings, Lists, Sets, Hashes, Sorted Sets, Streams, Geospatial, Bitmaps, Bitfields, JSON, Time Series
  • Advice: Pehle CLI samjho. Agar CLI aa gaya to kisi bhi language (Node.js, PHP, Go) me implement kar sakte ho.

7. Strings

7.1 Basic

  • String = normal data, koi complexity nahi.
  • Max size: 512 MB per string (zyaadatar cases ke liye kaafi se zyada).

7.2 SET aur GET

bash
SET name Piyush      # → OK
GET name             # → "Piyush"
  • OK = value set ho gayi.
  • GUI me refresh karo to key dikhegi.
  • Value GUI me edit karke dobara GET karo to updated value milti hai.

7.3 Key Naming Convention (Production Standard)

Galat: set name Piyush

Sahi: entity:id format

bash
SET user:1 Piyush
SET user:2 John
SET user:3 Jane

Soch: DB table jaisa socho:

id name
1 Piyush
2 John
3 Jane

Redis me yeh user:1, user:2, user:3 ban jaata hai.

Fayde:

  1. Keys descriptive hoti hain
  2. GUI me : delimiter ke basis pe keys auto-group (folder) ho jaati hain
  3. Keys dhoondhna aasan hota hai
bash
SET msg:1 hello
SET msg:2 hey

GUI me user folder (3 keys) aur msg folder (2 keys) alag dikhte hain. Jo key group me nahi thi (bina : ke), wo alag dikhti hai.

Note: Yeh zaruri nahi hai, par good practice hai aur production me aise hi use hota hai.

7.4 NX option


NX : not exists ; XX already exists 
  • NX = "Only set if key does NOT already exist"
bash
SET msg:3 "how are you" NX     # key nahi thi → OK
SET msg:3 "something_else" NX  # key pehle se hai → (nil), value change nahi hui
SET user:1 new_value NX        # (nil), kyunki user:1 exist karta hai (Piyush)
SET user:1 new_value           # NX ke bina → OK, value update ho gayi
  • Use case: Locks implement karna.

7.5 MGET aur MSET

bash
GET user:1                          # ek-ek karke
MGET user:1 user:2 msg:1 msg:2      # multiple values ek saath
MSET k1 v1 k2 v2                    # multiple set, ek hi transaction me

7.6 INCR / DECR (Counters)

bash
SET count 0
INCR count          # 1
INCR count          # 2
INCRBY count 10     # 12
DECR count          # decrement
DECRBY count 5

Use case: Website pe aaj kitne visitors aaye. Counter rakho, har visit pe INCR.

7.7 Aur bhi operations (instructor ne padhne ko bola)

  • Bitwise operations
  • GETRANGE (substring), SETRANGE
  • Docs me aur bhi hain, khud padho.

7.8 Node.js me Strings

Setup:

bash
mkdir redis-playground && cd redis-playground
code .
npm init -y
npm install ioredis

ioredis ek bahut popular package hai (weekly downloads bahut zyada).

client.js

js
const Redis = require("ioredis");
const client = new Redis();     // default: localhost:6379
module.exports = client;

Agar TypeScript hota to import use karte. Yahan plain Node.js hai to require.

string.js

js
const client = require("./client");

async function init() {
  // GET
  const result = await client.get("user:3");
  console.log("Result ->", result);

  // SET
  await client.set("msg:6", "Hey from Node.js");
  const val = await client.get("msg:6");
  console.log(val);

  // EXPIRE
  await client.expire("msg:6", 10);   // 10 sec baad auto-delete
}

init();     // function call karna mat bhulo!
bash
node string.js
  • GUI me msg:6 dikhega, value Hey from Node.js.

7.9 Expiry / TTL

  • GUI me TTL (Time To Live) column dikhta hai. "No limit" = expiry set nahi hai.
  • EXPIRE key 10 → 10 sec baad key automatically delete.
  • GUI me TTL ghatta hua dikhta hai (jaise 8, 6, 5...), phir key gayab. Uske baad GET → null.
  • Expiry CLI se bhi set kar sakte ho.

Expiry kyun zaruri hai? (Whiteboard example)

  • User → Server → DB (DB me sahi data), Redis (cache).
  • Agar cache hamesha rahega to DB me data badalne ke baad bhi purana (stale) data milega.
  • Isliye cache ko kabhi invalidate / expire karna padta hai.
  • Example: 6 ghante ka expiry. 6 ghante cached value dikhegi, phir key hat jaayegi, server DB se fresh data layega aur dobara cache karega.
  • Isi se rate limiting jaise features bhi bante hain (instructor ne bola baad me dikhayenge).

8. Lists

8.1 Concept

  • List = array jaisa. Docs ke hisaab se zyaadatar Stacks aur Queues implement karne ke liye, aur background worker systems ke queue management ke liye use hoti hai.
  • Same list ko Queue ya Stack dono bana sakte ho. Yeh tumhari implementation pe depend karta hai.

8.2 Visualize

LEFT (head)  [ ... ... ... ]  RIGHT (tail)
  • Stack banane ke liye array ko vertical socho, Queue ke liye horizontal.
  • apni mrji h ki khi se bhi push kro khi se bhi pop kro

8.3 Push commands

bash
LPUSH messages hey       # left se push
LPUSH messages hello     # ab hello sabse left me, hey uske baad
RPUSH messages bye       # right se push
  • List automatically ban jaati hai pehle push pe.
  • Return value = list ki current length.
  • State: hello, hey, bye
LRANGE messages 0 -1

Output:

1) "hello"
2) "hey"
3) "bye"

0 -1 ka matlab kya hai?

  • 0 → first element se start karo.

  • -1 → last element tak jao.


8.4 Pop commands

bash
LPOP messages     # left se nikalta hai → hello
RPOP messages     # right se nikalta hai → bye
  • Pop karne pe element list se nikal jaata hai.
  • Pehle LPOP → hello, phir RPOP → bye, to hey bacha.
  • Jab list khaali ho jaati hai to pop nil deta hai, aur length 0.

8.5 LLEN

bash
LLEN messages    # list ki length
  • Example: LPUSH messages 1, 2, 3, 4 ke baad → LLEN = 4.

8.6 Queue vs Stack

Insert Remove Behaviour
Queue Hamesha left se (LPUSH) Hamesha right se (RPOP) FIFO (First In First Out)
Stack Hamesha left se (LPUSH) Hamesha left se (LPOP) LIFO (Last In First Out)

8.7 Other commands

  • LMOVE: ek list ka element nikaal ke doosri list pe daalna
  • LTRIM: list ko trim (cut) karna

8.8 Blocking Commands (Important)

  • B = Blocking. BLPOP = Blocking LPOP.
  • Behaviour: Agar list empty hai, to command timeout tak wait karta hai jab tak koi element aa na jaye.
bash
BLPOP messages 10
Situation Result
List me elements hain Turant pop hota hai
List empty hai 10 sec tak atka rehta hai
10 sec me kuch nahi aaya Timeout, nil return
Wait ke dauraan doosre terminal se LPUSH messages 3 kiya Turant 3 return ho jaata hai
  • Fark: LPOP seedha nil deta hai, BLPOP wait karta hai.
  • Aur blocking variants: BLMPOP, BLMOVE.
  • Use case: Worker/consumer wait karta hai ki kab job aaye (polling ki zarurat nahi).

8.9 LRANGE (List padhna)

  • GET list pe kaam nahi karta (error: WRONGTYPE, kyunki GET strings ke liye hai).
bash
LRANGE messages 0 -1     # saari elements (0 se end tak)
LRANGE messages 0 1      # index 0 aur 1
LRANGE messages 0 3
LRANGE messages 1 3
  • -1 = last element.
  • Commands ratne ki zarurat nahi, bas samjho. Zarurat padne par docs se dekh lo.

8.10 DEL aur KEYS

bash
DEL messages          # key delete
KEYS user:*           # user se shuru hone wali saari keys
KEYS msg:*

Warning (production): KEYS pe dhyan do, badi DB me slow hota hai. SCAN use karo.

8.11 Limits aur Performance

  • Max list size: 2³² − 1 elements
  • Insertion: O(1)
  • Elements manipulate karne wali commands: generally O(N)

8.12 Node.js me Lists (list.js)

js
const client = require("./client");

async function init() {
  await client.lpush("messages", 1);
  await client.lpush("messages", 2);
  await client.lpush("messages", 3);
  await client.lpush("messages", 4);

  const result = await client.lpop("messages");
  console.log("Result ->", result);

  // Blocking pop: 40 sec tak wait
  const blocked = await client.blpop("messages", 40);
  console.log(blocked);
}

init();
  • Jab list khaali hoti hai, blpop atka rehta hai.
  • Doosre terminal se LPUSH messages hey karo to turant return ho jaata hai.
  • Instructor ka point: "sAgar CLI aati hai to Node.js bacchon ka khel hai."

9. Sets

9.1 Concept

  • DSA wale Set jaisa: unordered collection of unique strings.
  • Duplicates allowed nahi.
  • Docs ke hisaab se use cases:
    • Unique items track karna (jaise unique IP addresses)
    • Relations represent karna
    • Set operations: intersection, union, difference

9.2 Commands

bash
SADD ip 1 2 3         # (integer) 3, teeno naye add hue
SADD ip 1             # (integer) 0, already tha, add nahi hua, koi error nahi
SADD ip 4             # (integer) 1
SREM ip 3             # 3 remove
SISMEMBER ip 1        # 1 (true)
SISMEMBER ip 3        # 0 (false, remove ho chuka)
SISMEMBER ip 4        # 1
  • SADD return karta hai kitni values successfully add hui.
  • SISMEMBER → 1 (exists) / 0 (nahi).

9.3 Intersection (docs example)

bash
SADD bikes:racing:france bike:1 bike:2 bike:3
SADD bikes:racing:usa bike:1 bike:4
SINTER bikes:racing:france bikes:racing:usa    # → bike:1
  • SINTER = dono sets me jo common hai.
  • Example me bike:1 dono (France aur USA) racing me hai.
  • Return counts: Pehli baar 1 value → 1, same value dobara → 0, multiple values → count (e.g. 2), already existing → 0.
  • Aur commands: SCARD (cardinality / count), SUNION, SDIFF.

9.4 Limits

  • Max 2³² − 1 elements
  • Docs me time complexities diye hain, padhna chahiye.

9.5 Summary

  • Set chhota topic hai, par unique values store karne ke liye bahut useful.
  • Upar se intersection jaise operations bhi chala sakte ho.

10. Hashes

10.1 Concept

  • HashMap / Object jaisa: ek key ke andar field-value pairs.
  • DSA me HashMap ke saare operations O(1) hote hain, aur Redis hash me bhi zyaadatar commands O(1) hain. Isliye ye best data structures me se ek hai.
  • Max 2³² − 1 field-value pairs.

10.2 Commands

bike = {
    "model": "Deimos",
    "brand": "Ergonom",
    "type": "Enduro bikes",
    "price": 4972
}
bash
HSET bike:1 model Deimos brand Ergonom type "Enduro bikes" price 4972
HGET bike:1 model              # → Deimos
HGET bike:1 price              # → 4972
HMGET bike:1 model price       # multiple fields ek saath
HGETALL bike:1                 # saare fields
HINCRBY bike:1 price 100       # price + 100
HINCRBY bike:1 price -100      # price - 100 (decrement, negative value dene se)
  • HSET ke baad GUI me bike:1 ke andar fields (model, brand, type, price) aur unki values dikhti hain.

10.3 Node.js

js
await client.hset("bike:1", {
  model: "Deimos",
  brand: "Ergonom",
  type: "Enduro bikes",
  price: 4972,
});
const model = await client.hget("bike:1", "model");
  • Instructor ne coding detail me nahi ki ("tum log smart ho, dekh ke samajh jaoge").

Use cases: User profile, product info, session data.

11. Sorted Sets

11.1 Concept

  • Unique members, har member ka ek associated score.
  • Members hamesha score ke basis pe sorted rehte hain.
  • Priority Queue jaisa: element daalte time priority (score) do, aur wo automatically sort ho jaata hai.

11.2 Set vs Sorted Set

Set Sorted Set
Order Unordered Sorted by score
Add command SADD ZADD
Extra argument Nahi Score

11.3 Commands

bash
ZADD score 10 Piyush
ZADD score 1 John
ZADD score 2 Jane
ZRANGE score 0 -1            # John, Jane, Piyush (score ascending)
ZREVRANGE score 0 -1         # Piyush, Jane, John (reverse)
ZRANK score Piyush           # position
ZRANK score John             # 0
ZRANK score Jane             # 1
  • Naya member (jaise Pier) add karo to wo score ke hisaab se apni sahi position pe aata hai.
  • GUI me bhi hamesha sorted dikhta hai.
  • ZRANK = member ka index/position (0-based).

Note: Instructor ne kabhi "score" kabhi "rank" bola. Technically score = jo tum dete ho, rank = sorted position (0-indexed).
Tip: Docs ko shuru se padho, skip mat karo.

Use cases: Leaderboards, priority queues, trending items.

12. Streams

12.1 Concept

  • Docs ke hisaab se: append-only log jaisa data structure, aur typical append-only logs ki limitations ko door karne ke liye extra operations bhi hain.
  • Kafka ka alternative (Kafka bhi append-only log pe kaam karta hai, high throughput hai).
  • Redis me bhi high throughput milta hai, kyunki primary memory use hoti hai.
  • Insert O(1) hai, kyunki append-only.

12.2 Use cases

  • Event sourcing
  • User actions aur clicks track karna (bahut fast generate hone wala data)
  • Sensor monitoring (temperature sensor, speed sensor jo har second reading deta hai)
  • Notifications

12.3 Commands

Command Kaam
XADD Stream me nayi entry add
XREAD Entries read
XRANGE Range me entries read
XLEN Total entries
bash
XADD temperature:sensor1 * temp 30 pressure 1013 humidity 40
XRANGE temperature:sensor1 - +          # saari entries
XREAD COUNT 100 BLOCK 300 STREAMS temperature:sensor1 $
XLEN temperature:sensor1

12.4 Entry ID

  • Response me ek ID aati hai: <timestamp>-<sequence> (jaise 1712345678901-0).
  • Timestamp = entry kab bani.
  • Sequence number (0, 1, 2...) = agar same timestamp pe multiple entries aayein (jaise ek saath kai sensors), to ye number badhta hai. Isse concurrent data handle hota hai.
  • * = auto-generate ID.

12.5 XREAD (blocking)

  • XREAD COUNT 100 BLOCK 300 STREAMS key ... → 100 tak naye entries padho, aur blocking mode me wait karo agar nayi entry na ho.

Note: BLOCK ka unit milliseconds hota hai (300 = 300 ms), seconds nahi. Instructor ne seconds bola tha.

12.6 Practical pattern

  • Streams me data dump karte jao (clicks, sensor data...).
  • Ek cron job se kabhi-kabhi entries padho, DB me compute karke daalo, phir stream se saaf karo.

13. Geospatial Data

13.1 Concept

  • Latitude / Longitude wala data = geospatial data.
  • Example: Zomato delivery. Restaurant ka address, tumhare ghar ke coordinates, beech ki calculations.

13.2 Commands

bash
GEOADD hotels 77.2090 28.6139 hotel1
GEOADD hotels 77.1025 28.7041 hotel2
GEOSEARCH hotels FROMLONLAT 77.2000 28.6100 BYRADIUS 5 km WITHDIST

Dhyan rakho: Redis me pehle Longitude, phir Latitude aata hai (normal order ka ulta).

13.3 Use case: Hotel Finder

  1. DB/Redis me hotels ke coordinates store karo (GEOADD)
  2. User ki current location lo
  3. GEOSEARCH se 5 km radius ke andar ke hotels nikaalo
  4. Output me har hotel ki distance (WITHDIST) bhi milti hai (jaise Station 1 itni door, Station 2 itni door)

Note: Purane tutorials me GEORADIUS milega, wo ab deprecated hai. GEOSEARCH use karo.

14. Bitmaps, Bitfields aur Time Series

14.1 Bitmaps

  • Alag data type nahi, ye strings par bit-oriented operations hain (string ko bit vector ki tarah treat karte hain).
  • Commands: SETBIT, GETBIT.
  • Docs ka example: Sensor 1, 2, 3 ne server ko kisi date pe ping kiya ya nahi. Jaise satellites/airplanes jo log maintain karte hain ki kaun si machine kab ping kar rahi hai.
  • Fayda: Efficient set representations, aur docs ke hisaab se object permissions (har bit ek permission).
  • Instructor ki honesty: Unhone ye production me kabhi use hote nahi dekha, "knowledge ke liye hai".

14.2 Bitfields

  • Bitmaps jaisa advanced use case, production me kam use hota hai.

14.3 Time Series

  • Time series data: Jaise stock market data: 9:00 baje price kitna, 10:00 baje kitna, 11:00 baje kitna. Timeline pe analytics.
  • Instructor ne PostgreSQL se time-series kaam kiya hai, Redis me nahi, to unhe zyada pata nahi.
  • Redis Stack ka alag module hai (Redis TimeSeries), jo recently add hua hai.
  • Skip kar sakte ho.

14.4 JSON

  • Redis Stack me JSON data type bhi hai (module).

15. Production me Sabse Zyada Use hone wale Data Types

Instructor ke hisaab se:

  1. Strings
  2. Lists
  3. Sets
  4. Hashes
  5. Sorted Sets
  6. Streams
  7. Geospatial

Agar ye aa gaye to Redis "bahut achhe se aata hai".

Extra:

  • Redis me data pe search/query bhi kar sakte ho, par mat karo, kyunki wo kaam database ka hai. Redis ko key-value storage ki tarah use karo.

16. Pub/Sub

16.1 Concept

  • Publisher kisi channel pe message publish karta hai.
  • Subscribers us channel ko subscribe karte hain aur message turant receive karte hain.

16.2 Demo (do terminals)

Terminal 1 (subscriber):

bash
docker exec -it <id> redis-cli
SUBSCRIBE notifications

Terminal 2 (publisher):

bash
docker exec -it <id> redis-cli
PUBLISH notifications "hello"
  • Terminal 1 me message turant aa jaata hai.
  • Multiple channels ek saath subscribe kar sakte ho.

16.3 Use cases

  • Production me bahut use hota hai
  • Microservices architecture me WebSockets ko scale karna
  • Chat, live notifications

Important: Pub/Sub fire-and-forget hai. Agar subscriber offline hai, message miss ho jaayega. Persistent chahiye to Streams use karo.

17. Practical Project: Express API ko Redis se Fast banana

17.1 Goal

  • JSONPlaceholder (fake API) ka /todos endpoint bahut saara data return karta hai.
  • Hum apna server banayenge jo is API ko hit karta hai, aur uska response Redis me cache karega.

17.2 Setup

bash
npm install express axios

(ioredis pehle se installed, client.js reuse hoga)

17.3 Step 1: Bina cache wala server (server.js)

js
const express = require("express");
const axios = require("axios");

const app = express();

app.get("/", async (req, res) => {
  const { data } = await axios.get("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos");
  return res.json(data);
});

app.listen(9000);
bash
node server.js
  • Postman me http://localhost:9000 pe request karo.
  • Time: ~815 ms, ~1.7 sec (har baar slow).

17.4 Step 2: Redis cache ke saath

js
const express = require("express");
const axios = require("axios");
const client = require("./client");

const app = express();

app.get("/", async (req, res) => {
  // 1. Pehle cache check
  const cacheValue = await client.get("todos");
  if (cacheValue) return res.json(JSON.parse(cacheValue));   // CACHE HIT

  // 2. Cache miss: asli API se data
  const { data } = await axios.get("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos");

  // 3. Cache me store (string banake) + expiry
  await client.set("todos", JSON.stringify(data));
  await client.expire("todos", 30);

  return res.json(data);
});

app.listen(9000);

Pehle ek bug aaya tha: Hang ho gaya, kyunki Redis me object directly store nahi hota, string hi hota hai. Isliye:

  • Store karte time → JSON.stringify(data)
  • Wapas lete time → JSON.parse(cacheValue)
  • Code change ke baad server restart karna padta hai.

17.5 Results

Request Time
Pehli (cache miss) ~4.7 sec 🐢 (cache ban jaata hai)
Dusri, teesri... (cache hit) ~14 ms, 8 ms, 7 ms, 5 ms ⚡
Expiry ke baad (cache delete ho chuka) Phir slow (~464 ms), phir cache ban jaata hai
Uske baad phir Phir fast (~6-7 ms)
  • GUI me todos key dikhti hai, TTL ghatta hua, expire hone pe gayab.

17.6 Yaad rakhne wali baatein

  • Pattern: Cache check → miss to source se lo → cache me daalo (expiry ke saath) → return.
  • Expiry zaruri hai, warna hamesha cache wali (purani) value milti rahegi.

18. Instructor ka Real Production Example

  • Unki course website (learn... platform) bahut fast open hoti hai.
  • Redis me ye sab cache hota hai (production Redis ka RedisInsight dekh ke dikhaya):
Cached cheez Detail
Course reviews Review count, star ratings (average), individual reviews aur comments
PPP Purchasing Power Parity data
Assets Assets
  • Ye sab compute karna padta hai (kitni star rating, kitne reviews), isliye cache karte hain.
  • Keys pe proper limits/expiry lagi hain.
  • Jab naya review aata hai to cache automatically update/invalidate ho jaata hai, to fresh data milta hai.
  • Result: refresh karo to page bahut fast load hota hai.

20. Best Practices (Instructor ki advice)

  1. CLI pehle seekho, phir kisi bhi language me implement karna easy hai.
  2. Commands ratne ki zarurat nahi, redis.io docs padhna aana chahiye. Docs ko shuru se padho, skip mat karo.
  3. Keys ko entity:id format me do.
  4. Cache pe hamesha TTL lagao.
  5. GUI sirf learning ke liye, production me CLI/code.
  6. Docker use karo, sab same environment pe.
  7. Redis ko DB ka replacement nahi, speed layer samjho.
  8. Redis pe data search/query mat karo, wo DB ka kaam hai.

Extra tips (video ke bahar se)

  • SET key value EX 10 = set + expiry ek atomic command me.
  • Lock ke liye: SET lock:order:1 "1" NX EX 30.
  • Production me KEYS * avoid karo, SCAN use karo.
  • Cache invalidation: TTL ya data change hone pe key delete/update.

21. Interview Quick Answers

Question Answer
Redis kya hai? In-memory key-value data store; cache, queue aur message broker ki tarah use hota hai
Redis fast kyun hai? Data RAM me hota hai, simple aur optimized data structures
Cache hit vs miss? Hit = Redis me mila, Miss = DB jaana pada
Cache invalidation? TTL lagake, ya data change pe key delete/update
Queue kaise banayenge? LPUSH + RPOP (blocking ke liye BRPOP)
Stack kaise banayenge? LPUSH + LPOP
Leaderboard? Sorted Set (ZADD + ZREVRANGE)
Unique visitors? Set (SADD)
Object store karna? Hash (HSET)
Pub/Sub vs Streams? Pub/Sub fire-and-forget, Streams persistent log
Redis ko DB ki jagah use kar sakte hain? Nahi, ye speed layer hai, source of truth DB hi rahe
